hookups.source: https://hartsprings.com/faq/ ('The RV Campground sites all have 20/50 amp service with water and septic'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Sites 1-71 on the park's site map; ReserveAmerica sells 67 of them as Standard Full Hookup, all back-in, 41 taking 50 ft and the rest 28-45 ft. Up to 8 people and two vehicles per site; one RV per site.

sites.source: https://hartsprings.com/reserve-your-rv-spot/ ('click on the site number (1-71) of your desired site') + https://hartsprings.com/rules/ ('All RV Sites are back-in, No sites are pull through', 'Maximum of 8 people per site') + https://www.reserveamerica.com/explore/hart-springs/PRCG/1063150/campsites (Equipment Length / Driveway: 50 Back-In x41, 45, 40 x5, 36 x9, 34, 32 x3, 30 x4, 28 x3), read 2026-10-21

values.note: RV park bathhouse with hot showers, restrooms and washers/dryers; pool for registered campers. Wi-Fi is limited, 'best suited for checking emails'. No generators; EV charging prohibited.

facilities.source: https://hartsprings.com/faq/ ('access to the RV Park's Bathhouse which contains hot showers, restrooms, and washers/dryers', 'The office/store is open from 9 am -5 pm', 'Hart Springs has limited WIFI which is best suited for checking emails', 'Charging of EV's is Prohibited') + https://hartsprings.com/rules/ ('The Pool is for Registered Campers to the RV Park only', 'No generators'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All reservations must be made at least one day in advance'; for short notice the park office is (352) 463-3444. Monthly rate needs 30 consecutive nights on one site.

booking.source: https://hartsprings.com/accommodations/ ('All reservations must be made at least one day in advance') + https://hartsprings.com/rules/ ('All reservations are asked to be made 24hrs in advance') + https://hartsprings.com/faq/ ('Reservations for the RV Campground are made online through Reserve America') + https://www.reserveamerica.com/explore/hart-springs/PRCG/1063150/campsites ('Monthly Rate Notice'), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://www.reserveamerica.com/explore/hart-springs/PRCG/1063150/campsites ('Discount Policy: Presently we offer Military discounts (max. 6 day stay)... An active Military ID, or DD214 is accepted'), read 2026-10-21

note: Gilchrist County park at Hart Springs on the Suwannee River; full-hookup sites under oak canopy, a spring-fed swimming area, boardwalk, pool and splash pad. Pets (2 max) are allowed in the RV campground but not in the springs park, pool or buildings; no alcohol anywhere on the grounds. --Claude
summary: County's own pages + its ReserveAmerica catalog: confirmed 50-amp full hookups, 71 sites, showers/laundry/store, ReserveAmerica booking. Changed max_rig_ft 60 -> 50 (RA catalog tops out at 50 ft, all back-in); added pull_through false, limited Wi-Fi, a 1-day-ahead booking cutoff, a military discount. Note cleaned (60-ft claim wrong; hookups/booking/RV Life lines redundant). Fees ($45, county rate sheet 2026-04-06) left as read 10-14. No closure notice.
